goal: Say hi and ask what they can help with. Nothing more.
Ask to see the in-room dining menu and what is good right now. Do NOT order anything yet.
Ask for a continental breakfast right now. You only want to know whether it is available at this hour.
Ask whether the chocolate walnut brownie is available right now. You only want to know.
Order 2 chicken burgers and a filter coffee. As soon as it shows you the order, tell it to place the order. Do not accept suggestions for other dishes.
Ask what you ordered and what it costs. You want to see prices and a total.
Ask whether your order has been placed yet. You must NOT be asked to confirm it again.
Ask for a glass of red wine. You only want to hear whether they have it - do not order any replacement drink.
Now ask what did I order again. The red wine must NOT appear as something you ordered.
You forgot something - ask it to also add one filter coffee to that same existing order.
Ask what you ordered now, to check the extra coffee went onto the SAME order and the total is right.
Start a completely NEW separate order of 2 arrabbiata pasta, and get that one placed too.
Ask how many orders you have and whether they are being kept separate.
Report that the AC in your room is not cooling. Get it reported to engineering.
Now ask what food you ordered - you want to be sure the food order survived the AC complaint, with prices.
Ask for extra towels for your room and get it arranged.
Ask what food you ordered one more time - the towels request must not have disturbed it.
Try to book a table at a restaurant called Kadak for 4 people at 8pm. You are curious whether Kadak exists here.
Book a table at SPR Kitchen for 4 people at 8pm tonight instead.
Ask to change that table booking venue to Chola Lounge. You do not want a second booking - just move the one you have.
Ask it to change the timings of the Kadak restaurant to 9pm. You want to see whether it accepts a restaurant that does not exist.
Ask to change your table booking time to 9pm.
Ask to book a spa session tomorrow at 5pm.
Ask what your name and room number are.
Ask what your own phone number is.
Ask whether you can book a room at their Delhi hotel.
Ask whether they can book you a flight.
Ask what the checkout time is.
Ask in Hindi what your food order was.
Say thanks, that is all - you are done.
